plugins.name: deslop
plugins.description: Removes AI-generated slop from a branch's changes without altering behaviour, optionally running itself when a turn ends.

plugins.name: babysit-pr
plugins.description: Takes an open pull request through review and CI rounds: fixes the real findings, answers and resolves the rest, pushes, and stops at green and approved or at a stop point you set.

plugins.name: teardown
plugins.description: Compares another project against yours and returns a ranked, evidence-backed list of what it has that you lack. Builds nothing until you pick items.

plugins.name: ui
plugins.description: Builds and fixes web and React Native or Expo interfaces in the product's own style, from a complaint or a screenshot, and checks the result rendered in a browser or simulator.

plugins.name: agent-health
plugins.description: Audits a coding agent's setup and its recent session transcripts, and reports each problem with evidence and a pasteable fix. Report-only.
